summary: The filing is a routine 8-K reporting an extension and pricing-change on an existing loan financing facility. Angel Oak Mortgage REIT and two subsidiaries extended their facility with Multinational Bank 1 through September 25, 2026 under rolling three-month renewals, and the interest-rate spread was reduced from a prior 1.65%-2.10% range to 1.30%-2.10%. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is present. The event is an ordinary credit-facility amendment with no special-situation implication.
